//: Keyboard-mode shortcuts. Press Esc anywhere in SLICC to enter keyboard mode;
the keys below then work on their own, with no modifier. Edit this file and
reload the tab to change them — it is read once at startup.
Each entry is "key": "command". A key is a single character ("x") or a named
key ("Enter"). Several keys may share one command. Set a key to null to unbind
it. A command with no key left is simply unreachable from the keyboard.
Commands: nextAgent, composer, newConversation, leftRail, rightRail, files,
tabs, terminal, memory, sprinkles, model, accounts, help.
Esc and the digits 1-9 are reserved: Esc is the mode itself, and the digits
address the tab strip by position (9 is always the last agent).
This file is yours — SLICC only writes it once, when it is missing.
